evidence: src/infrastructure/persistence/InMemoryProductRepository.ts: class InMemoryProductRepository implements ProductRepository, which is a persistence adapter in the infrastructure layer.
findById/findAll use Product.restore(record) to rebuild entities from stored snapshots. This is persistence mapping only, with no business decisions.
save(product) calls this.records.set(product.id, product.toSnapshot()). This is pure storage with no validation or business rules.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: InMemoryProductRepository only does persistence work, which is the job of the infrastructure layer. It contains no business rules, validation, pricing or stock logic, and no orchestration of use cases. Turning entities into snapshots and back is ordinary repository-adapter work.
